summary: Dense right lung opacification on prior has markedly cleared on current, revealing aerated lung markings.

findings.rationale: Prior shows dense homogeneous opacity obscuring most of the right lung from the hilum downward. Current shows this region substantially clearer with visible vascular/lung markings. Caveat: the prior image is cropped near the diaphragm so a costophrenic meniscus could not be directly confirmed, and consolidation cannot be fully excluded.
